_comment: Template for usage_counters/{YYYY-MM} documents. Key format: '2026-08'
_usage: A new document matching this shape is created by the dispatch Cloud Function at the start of each calendar month when no document yet exists for that month.
_softCapWhatsapp_note: Conservative soft cap on business-initiated WhatsApp template sends per month. Adjust based on observed usage and Meta's template messaging limits for your account tier.
_updatedAt_template_sentinel: The null value is a non-deployable JSON template sentinel. The backend must replace it with a Firestore server timestamp on creation and every counter update.
_ola_note: Ola request and origin×destination pair counts are distinct. This template intentionally contains no authoritative production Ola cost cap; dispatch_config/main.olaMonthlyPairCap remains null until deployment evidence supplies one. Legacy olaMapsMatrixCalls and softCapOlaMaps values, if present on old documents, are migration-only and not authoritative.
